body.statement: For fixed \(d\), rational empirical input, and \(0<\epsilon<1\), \(\mathsf{CertMOT}_\epsilon\) returns \(\underline L_\epsilon\le L(\widehat{\mathbf P})\le\overline L_\epsilon\) with \(\overline L_\epsilon-\underline L_\epsilon\le\epsilon\), together with primal and dual witnesses, in time polynomial in the input bit length, \(N\), and \((K/\epsilon)^d\).
body.justification: A statistical rate is operational only if numerical error is separated from sampling error by an auditable certificate.
body.gap: Generic discrete MOT has \(m^K\) columns and generic pairwise MOT is hard; existing entropic solvers certify regularized or approximate objectives without this fixed-\(d\) squared-sum bracket.
body.consumer: The empirical lower endpoint and its confidence correction can report a numerical error budget rather than silently absorbing Sinkhorn bias.
